shared_elements: low relief carved on a large flat rectangular stone surface
bird's head shown in profile with prominent curved beak and round eye
handled object (bag/bucket-like form with an arched handle)
figures rendered in strict profile against a plain ground
elongated serpentine/limb forms filling the lower field
justification: The most specific correspondence is the pairing of a hook-beaked bird head in profile with an arch-handled bag/bucket-shaped object, present in both, plus the shared format of shallow relief on a large flat stone panel. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a crowded, schematic multi-register composition of small animals and repeated motifs on an irregular weathered block, while B is a single monumental, anatomically modelled winged figure filling the whole smooth panel, so arrangement and carving manner have little in common.
